verdict.rationale: FireHydrant's docs describe webhooks that fire on internal events and send data to external systems. The API can set up webhooks programmatically, and Signals webhook alert targets and a Runbook 'send a webhook' step provide further outbound HTTP callbacks to endpoints you register. missing for 10: documented event-type catalog and payload schemas, delivery guarantees such as signing, retries and verification, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: FireHydrant enables you to create webhooks that respond to internal events or custom commands to send information to external systems.
You can use the FireHydrant API to configure integrations, define incidents, and set up webhooks--anything you can do on the FireHydrant UI.
Webhook targets on FireHydrant allow alerts to be sent to external destinations via a webhook.
This article explains how to set up a Runbook step that sends a webhook to an endpoint of your choice.
